name: Aurora Gradient
what_it_means: Aurora (or mesh-gradient) design uses large, blurred, flowing gradients that resemble the northern lights, usually on dark backgrounds. The gradient is the brand: it moves slowly, glows behind content and gives modern AI and tech products an energetic, premium feel.
signature_moves: Large blurred mesh gradients, often animated
Clean sans type and minimal UI on top
best_for: AI products, SaaS launches, crypto, developer tools
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a hero section for [AI PRODUCT] in an Aurora Gradient style. Near-black background (#07070C) with a large, softly blurred aurora mesh gradient (violet #6A5BFF, teal #00D1B2, magenta #FF4FD8) flowing behind the headline and slowly animating (20s loop). Add fine noise to prevent banding. Headline in Geist/Inter semibold 72px, white, tight tracking, with a small pill announcement badge above it. A glowing primary button with a gradient border, and a product screenshot below with a light-beam glow on its top edge. Keep UI minimal so the light is the hero.
